# TestScript for 29-feature-toggles — environment activation.
# The env tag names a single key=value variable that overlays the field
# defaults. Environment outranks config and struct defaults.

# Isolate the conventional XDG config tier from the host machine.
env HOME=$WORK/home
env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/xdg

# 1. Activating http3 reveals the experimental listener flag.
env API_FEATURES=http3=true
exec feature-toggles --quic
stdout 'listen=:8080 cache=128 quic=true insecure=false'
stdout 'features: http3=true admin-api=false strict-tls=true metrics=true'
exec feature-toggles --help
stdout 'QUIC/HTTP3'

# 2. Disabling strict-tls retires the plaintext escape hatch.
env API_FEATURES=strict-tls=false
exec feature-toggles --allow-insecure
stdout 'insecure=true'
stdout 'features: http3=false admin-api=false strict-tls=false metrics=true'

# 3. Activating admin-api reveals the experimental subcommand.
env API_FEATURES=admin-api=true
exec feature-toggles admin
stdout 'admin: API listening on :9090'

# 4. Environment outranks a struct default: metrics can be switched off again.
env API_FEATURES=metrics=false
exec feature-toggles
! stdout 'metrics:'
